title: Overview
description: A high-level introduction to the React library, its purpose, and key features. This section covers what React is and how it helps in building user interfaces.

title: Getting Started
description: A practical guide to setting up a simple React application, demonstrating the basic usage with a working code example to get you started quickly.

title: API Reference
description: A comprehensive reference for all public APIs exported by the React package. Use this section to find detailed information on specific functions, classes, and hooks.

title: Hooks
description: Detailed documentation for all built-in React Hooks, such as useState, useEffect, and useContext, with usage examples for each.

title: Components & Classes
description: Reference for built-in components and classes like Component, PureComponent, Fragment, and Suspense, which form the foundation of React applications.

title: Top-Level APIs
description: Documentation for top-level React functions such as createElement, createContext, forwardRef, lazy, and memo, used for various advanced patterns and optimizations.

title: React.Children
description: A guide to using the React.Children utility for working with the props.children data structure, allowing for powerful manipulation and inspection of child elements.

title: Advanced Guides
description: Explores advanced topics, environments, and features for experienced React developers looking to optimize their applications or use cutting-edge functionality.

title: Server Environment
description: Explains the APIs and exports available specifically for server environments, including React Server Components and data tainting for security.

title: JSX Runtime
description: Details on the modern JSX transform and the jsx and jsxs functions it compiles to, including environment-specific runtimes.

title: Compiler Runtime
description: Information on the experimental React Compiler ('Forget') and the runtime helpers it uses to optimize your components automatically.

title: Experimental APIs
description: Documentation for unstable and experimental APIs that are subject to change. Use these features with caution in production environments.

title: Package Information
description: Provides metadata about the `react` npm package, including the current version, license, repository links, and dependencies.
